identity.rule: The person is the person in the reference images. Only the views described below change.

hero.content: seen straight from the front, standing, the whole person visible from the top of the head to both feet, arms relaxed at the sides, neutral expression with the mouth closed

grid.reading_order: left to right, top to bottom

cells.view: the whole person visible from the top of the head to the feet, walking toward the camera mid-stride, relaxed expression
the whole person visible from the top of the head to the feet, sitting on a plain grey stool, one knee raised, hands resting on the knee, relaxed expression
the whole person visible from the top of the head to the feet, standing with both arms crossed over the chest, relaxed expression
the whole person visible from the top of the head to the feet, standing with one hand on the hip, weight on one leg, relaxed expression
the whole person visible from the top of the head to the feet, crouching low, forearms resting on the knees, relaxed expression
the whole person visible from the top of the head to the feet, seen from behind, looking back over the shoulder toward the camera, relaxed expression
the whole person visible from the top of the head to the feet, standing with both hands in the pockets, leaning slightly to one side, relaxed expression
the whole person visible from the top of the head to the feet, one hand lifted, tucking hair behind the ear, head slightly tilted, relaxed expression

locks.background_grey: Soft grey seamless studio background, the same grey behind every view.
locks.identity_close_person: Keep the face and identity exactly as in the reference images.
locks.no_text: No text, no labels, no watermark.
locks.lighting_flat: Flat even softbox lighting, no hard shadows.
locks.camera_full_body: Eye level, 35mm, the whole person inside every panel at the same scale.
locks.same_clothes: The same clothes as in the reference images in every view.

consistency: Every panel shows the same person in the same clothes at the same scale. Only the pose differs between panels and no two panels repeat a pose.
must_avoid: No borders and no drop shadows between the panels.
Leave a clear strip of empty grey background between neighbouring panels; no figure overlaps another panel.
Do not crop the head, hands or feet at a panel edge.
No props other than the plain grey stool.
